From stacked FITS to finished picture

An automatic starting look

Open the stacked FITS file from your telescope. StellarFITS recognises the target and gives it a look tuned for that kind of object - nebula, galaxy, cluster or the Moon.

Then make it yours

Live sliders for brightness, colour, contrast, stars and noise - every change shows straight away. Simple mode for the essentials, Advanced for everything.

Starting looks & presets

Pick Natural, Balanced, Vivid or Soft with a preview of your own picture, and save your favourite settings as presets for next time.

Stars handled properly

Works with the free StarNet2 to process stars and nebula separately - cleaner stars, a stronger nebula, the stars always put back. GraXpert removes light pollution.

The Moon too

Moon stacks get their own processing: the disc framed on black, the colour cast removed, crisp crater detail and the Moon's real mineral colours.

Full-resolution export

JPG, PNG or 16-bit TIFF, any size, with an optional information line. Batch-process a whole folder, or combine several nights into one deeper stack.

Made with StellarFITS

Examples taken with a Dwarf 2 and processed with StellarFITS.

About this beta

Your feedback shapes StellarFITS

This is the first public beta. Please try it on your own stacks - different targets, telescopes and nights - and tell us what looked wrong, what was confusing and what you liked.

In the app: Tools → Send feedback (it adds the app and PC details for you). Or email support@stellarfits.co.uk. A screenshot helps a lot.

New betas: StellarFITS shows a small New version link when one is out.

Good to know
  • Windows 10 and 11 (64-bit), about 250 MB. No administrator rights needed.
  • Uses the stacked FITS file from your telescope - not the JPG.
  • StarNet2 and GraXpert are optional free programs by other authors - StellarFITS shows you how to add them.
  • Your FITS files are never changed.
  • Not yet: mono stacks, crop / rotate, the Sun, Mac.

StellarFITS is free. If it helps your pictures, you can buy me a coffee ☕ - entirely optional, and very much appreciated.
